metadata.source: CWE Top 25 Most Dangerous Software Weaknesses
metadata.provenance: Synthesized from CWE Top 25 public list (https://cwe.mitre.org/top25/), not verbatim, with our own descriptions

cwe_top25.name: Cross-site Scripting
cwe_top25.description: Improper neutralization of input during web page generation leads to XSS.
cwe_top25.testing: Reflected, stored, DOM XSS via payloads in inputs, headers, etc.
cwe_top25.remediation: Output encoding, Content Security Policy, validate input

cwe_top25.name: SQL Injection
cwe_top25.description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in SQL command leads to SQLi.
cwe_top25.testing: Test with single quote, time-based, boolean-based, union-based

cwe_top25.name: Improper Input Validation
cwe_top25.description: Product receives input or data, but does not validate or incorrectly validates.

cwe_top25.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery
cwe_top25.description: Web app does not verify request was intentionally provided by user.

cwe_top25.name: Path Traversal
cwe_top25.description: Improper limitation of pathname to restricted directory.
cwe_top25.testing: Test with traversal payloads in file params
cwe_top25.remediation: Validate file paths, use allow list, chroot

cwe_top25.name: Out-of-bounds Read
cwe_top25.description: Software reads data past end or before beginning of buffer.

cwe_top25.name: OS Command Injection
cwe_top25.description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in OS command.
cwe_top25.testing: Test with command injection payloads in inputs that might go to OS
cwe_top25.remediation: Avoid OS calls, validate input, least privilege

cwe_top25.name: Missing Authorization
cwe_top25.description: Software does not perform authorization check when actor attempts to access resource.
cwe_top25.testing: Test IDOR/BOLA by changing IDs, test BFLA
cwe_top25.remediation: Check authorization for every request, deny by default

cwe_top25.name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
cwe_top25.description: Software allows upload of dangerous file type without validation.
cwe_top25.testing: Upload php, jsp, etc. if file upload exists
cwe_top25.remediation: Validate file type, extension, content, store outside web root

cwe_top25.name: Code Injection
cwe_top25.description: Improper control of generation of code.
